name: CSF cytology – TIS categories applied to CSF (proposed; no official CSF system)
use: Detection of leptomeningeal malignancy, infection, inflammation.
not_use: Not a validated international system – proposed tiered schemes only.

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Process fresh (<1–2 h) or refrigerate; ≥3–5 mL (ideally ≥10 mL for malignancy).

extra.title: Status
items: There is no official international CSF reporting system. Published proposals apply the International System for Serous Fluid Cytopathology (TIS) five categories to CSF.
Adaptation used in one study: only acellular samples treated as non-diagnostic.
TIS categories also stratified overall survival in a 3-centre CSF cohort (Cancer Cytopathol 2026).

references: Application of the International System for Serous Fluid Cytopathology in Cerebrospinal Fluid Cytology. Cytopathology 2025 (doi 10.1111/cyt.70015).
